senses.gloss:
(I)--a king and the son of Bandhu. (Budha- वि। प्।). His queen was अलम्बुषा. Father of a number of sons and a daughter चेडवीडा.
1: भा. IX. 2. ३०-31; Br. III. 8. ३६-7; ६१. १०; Vi. IV. 1. ४६-7.
(इलविला-वि। प्।). Lust after more territory.
2: भा. XII. 3. १०.
Lived at the commencement of the third [page२-034+ २९] त्रेतायुग. His daughter was द्रविडा. Many kings of विशाल ruled by his grace.
3: वा 86. १५-16, २२.
Begot an Apsaras, आलम्बुषा, a son विशाल who began the वैशाल line of kings which ended with Sumati.
4: Vi. IV. 1. ४८-9, ५९.
(II)--the २७थ् Veda व्यास, learnt the ब्र्। पुराण and the वायु पुराण from सोमशुष्म and narrated the former to दक्ष. Br. II. ३५. १२३; IV. 4. ६४-65; वा. १०३. ६४.
(III)--a sage who got freed from a curse at ऋसितीर्थम् on the नर्मदा. M. १९३. १३.
(IV)--the Veda-व्यास of the २३र्द् (२४थ्- वि। प्।) द्वापर; श्वेत, the अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. २०३; Vi. III. 3. १७.
(V)--the son of Dama and a king at the beginning of the third त्रेतायुग in the ११थ् Manvantara; had a daughter इडिविला, who was married to पौलश्त्य. वा. ७०. ३०-1.
--heard the ब्र्। and वायु पुराणस् from कृतम्जय and narrated the former to भरद्वाज. Br. IV. 4. ६३; वा. १०३. ६३.

--an Asura friend of Kamsa; created a whirl- wind which covered all Gokulam with dust and took the baby कृष्ण high in the sky. कृष्ण caught hold of his neck and the demon, unable to bear his weight, fell down dead to the wonder of all Gopas and गोपीस्. भा. X. 2. 1; 7. २०-32; २६. 6; ४६. २६; Br. IV. २९. १२४. [page२-035+ २८]
